subject: math

objective.text: Subtract measurements when you must unbundle twice, even when the top number has zeros.

explanations.title: Unbundle twice
explanations.text: 223 minus 194: not enough ones, so unbundle a ten. Not enough tens, so unbundle a hundred. Then subtract.

explanations.title: When the tens digit is zero
explanations.text: 703 has 0 tens, so you cannot unbundle a ten yet. First change 1 hundred into 10 tens. Then change 1 ten into 10 ones.

explanations.title: Prepare before subtracting
explanations.text: Unbundle every place that needs it before you subtract anything.

source_ref.section: Concept Development (Students should prepare their problems... before performing the operation.)

examples.title: 223 g minus 194 g
examples.text: Unbundle: 1 hundred, 11 tens, 13 ones. 13 minus 4 is 9. 11 minus 9 is 2. 1 minus 1 is 0. The apple is 29 grams heavier.

examples.title: 703 mL minus 124 mL
examples.text: 703 becomes 6 hundreds, 9 tens and 13 ones. Subtract to get 579 milliliters.

questions.text: 42 tens minus 5 tens equals how many tens?

questions.text: An apple and an orange weigh 417 grams together. The apple weighs 223 grams. What does the orange weigh?
223 minus 194. After you unbundle 1 ten, how many tens and ones are there?

764 grams minus 485 grams equals what number?
703 minus 124. The tens digit is 0. What do you unbundle first?
Kerrin had 703 milliliters. Now 124 milliliters are left. How much did she pour out?
500 grams minus 467 grams equals what number?
641 grams minus 387 grams equals what number?
700 milliliters minus 452 milliliters equals what number?
5 liters 920 milliliters minus 3 liters 869 milliliters. What is left?
The drive is 617 kilometers. David has 468 kilometers left. How far has he driven?
Tank B holds 400 liters. Tank A holds 165 fewer liters. How much does Tank A hold?
A cow weighs 725 kilograms. The sheep weighs 647 kilograms less. How much does the sheep weigh?
Why is it important to unbundle all your units before you subtract?

hints.text: Check each place. Are there enough ones? Enough tens?
Not enough? Unbundle 1 from the next bigger place into 10.
Zero tens? Unbundle a hundred into 10 tens first. Then unbundle a ten.
Draw a tape diagram. To find a missing part or a difference, subtract.
Say it in units: 42 tens minus 5 tens.
Is the tens digit 5 or more? Then round up to the next hundred.
